overview_description.description: Velt is the complete collaboration toolkit for SaaS. With a full-stack SDK and APIs, product teams embed contextual comments, notifications, async recordings, CRDT-based multiplayer editing, presence, and huddles directly inside their apps—in days, not months. Built for B2B products, Velt is developer-first and enterprise-ready, helping teams ship rich, in-product collaboration without rebuilding realtime infra or compliance plumbing.
